concepts.gloss_en: The first teshuvah (repentance) — the first of the two teshuvahs in Torah 6, corresponding to the glory of this world (as opposed to the second teshuvah / olam haba)

members.note: same referent — the definite adjective הראשונה makes the phrase definite ('the first teshuvah') even with anarthrous noun; both used in lm1:6 for the same first teshuvah. Difference is only the article on the head noun, and both readings are definite, so no archetype ambiguity here.

notes: Both forms are definite ('the first teshuvah') since the adjective carries the article in both; they name the same ordinal-designated teshuvah in Torah 6. The proof quote attached to התשובה הראשונה shows only מדת התשובה generally, but the form itself specifies 'first', matching תשובה הראשונה = aspect of the glory of this world. Merged as 'likely' rather than 'obvious' because only one usage each is cited.
